title: search_intent
description: Personalized job search intent derived from a user's resume. Generated by the /mrweirdo-onboard skill (which has the main agent session read the PDF and produce this JSON inline — no separate fetch + API key). Persisted to ~/.mrweirdo-jobs/search_intent.json. Consumed by the Discovery layer to drive cross-platform job sourcing without any hard-coded major / industry preference.

user_summary.description: Structured profile facts pulled from the resume that the search needs. Distinct from ~/.mrweirdo-jobs/profile.json (which is form-fill data); this is search-relevant facts only.

education_level.description: undergraduate | masters | phd | bootcamp | community-college | other

year_or_status.description: freshman | sophomore | junior | senior | masters-year-1 | masters-year-2 | gap-year | etc. Null if not derivable.

graduation_target.description: ISO year-month (e.g. '2027-05') or free-text ('May 2027'). Drives intern vs new-grad routing.

school.description: Institution name as it appears on the resume.

field_of_study.description: Major / concentration in the user's own wording (do NOT bucket into preset categories). 'Marketing', 'Mechanical Engineering', 'Nursing', 'Studio Art', 'Pre-Med Biology', 'Liberal Arts', etc.

work_authorization.description: Self-reported: 'US Citizen' | 'F-1 Student' | 'F-1 OPT' | 'F-1 CPT' | 'H-1B' | 'Green Card' | 'Other' | null.

needs_sponsorship.description: True if the user will need visa sponsorship for FT work. Null if undeterminable.

search_intent.description: AI-derived signal of what jobs this user is actually looking for. Designed to be major-agnostic and function-agnostic — works equally for Business / CS / Accounting / Marketing / Nursing / Fine Arts / Engineering / Pre-Law / Public Health / Journalism / etc. Target function is anchored on the user's explicit direction first, then resume evidence; the major is evidence, not destiny.

role_categories.description: Specific role titles to search for, derived from the user's self-reported target functions plus resume-supported evidence. NOT preset enums and not major-derived defaults. Examples: 'Software Engineering Intern' / 'Accounting Intern' / 'Clinical Research Coordinator Intern' / 'Curatorial Assistant Internship' / 'Mechanical Design Engineer Intern'. Exploratory low-priority categories must still be adjacent to the target-function anchor.

title_pattern.description: Phrase to feed into search engines / ATS keyword filters. Should match how recruiters actually post.

priority.description: high = direct target-function match; medium = adjacent / stretch within the same or nearby function family; low = exploratory but still adjacent. Low does not mean cross-functional.

rationale.description: 1-sentence why this fits the user's target-function anchor and resume evidence. Used in audit + debugging.

industry_targets.description: Industries / sectors the user appears oriented toward. Free-text, not preset. Examples: 'AI/ML', 'Consumer Healthcare', 'Nonprofit Advocacy', 'Architecture & Design', 'Public Policy'.

target_function_anchor.description: Functional boundary used by discovery, scoring, and auto-apply gating. If the user explicitly stated target functions, those win over major-derived guesses. Resume evidence can broaden to adjacent functions, but cannot override an explicit target.

self_reported_target_functions.description: Functions the user explicitly wants, in the user's wording. Examples: ['Operations', 'Product Management'] or ['Software Engineering'].

resume_supported_functions.description: Functions supported by resume experience, projects, coursework, licenses, or portfolio evidence.

adjacent_functions.description: Nearby functions that can be searched/scored as adjacent. Examples: Ops/PM may include BizOps, Strategy, APM, Program Management; SWE may include Backend, Frontend, Full-Stack, Platform, DevOps, QA, or technical internships.

excluded_functions.description: Functions that should not enter auto-apply because they are too far from the anchor. Must not be inferred solely from major; derive from explicit target direction plus role_categories.

rationale.description: Short explanation of the direct/adjacent/excluded boundary.

function_area.description: Array of user target-function preferences in free text. Examples: ['Software Engineering'] / ['Accounting'] / ['Operations', 'Product Management'] / ['Nursing'] / ['Design'] / ['Consulting']. Null only if user truly has no functional preference. Do not derive this solely from major.

target_cycle.description: Intern cycles user is targeting, inferred from self-introduction/resume or a later follow-up. Examples: ['Summer 2026'] / ['Summer 2026', 'Fall 2026'].

target_company_tiers.description: Company-tier preferences only when the user states or strongly implies them. Empty/null = no preference. Do not assume startup interest.

salary_floor_hourly.description: Minimum hourly wage user will accept for intern roles when explicitly stated in self-introduction or a later follow-up. Soft signal for scoring.

target_companies.description: Optional. Companies scanned first on every run (restart-apply 名单优先). slug = the public job-board slug, verified against the board API; it is also the company name everywhere downstream (label is display only). Lever entries are reported as paused, not fetched.

exclude_role_keywords.description: Role title fragments that should DROP results (whole-word, case-insensitive). Derived from the target-function anchor and obvious noise. Do not use one universal exclusion list: a SWE-seeking user must not exclude 'software engineer', while an Ops/PM-seeking user may exclude distant engineering/clinical/design/data roles when those are outside the stated target.

primary_country.description: Should default to 'US' unless resume strongly suggests otherwise.

preferred_metros.description: Derived from school location (commute radius) + any city mentions on the resume + the hard-boundary relocation answer. For broad relocation, use sentinel values like 'Anywhere US' and/or 'China'.

countries_open_to.description: Country codes the user is willing and legally able to consider for internships, e.g. ['US'] or ['US','CN'].

relocation_policy.description: From the hard-boundary relocation answer. Determines whether location-specific ATS questions can be answered yes or must be treated as user-answer blockers.

willing_to_relocate_for_internship.description: True only when the user explicitly says they will relocate for an internship.

work_mode_preference.description: Inferred from self-introduction/location policy or a later follow-up. 'onsite_pref' = Onsite > Hybrid > Remote ranking.

seniority.description: Legacy single seniority field. Prefer role_type_targets for new profiles.

role_type_targets.description: Hard target role types selected by the user. Auto-apply must only dispatch rows whose role_type_match is in this list.

caliber_signals.description: Hints for the downstream AI scorer about what tier of company is realistic — keeps the funnel honest.

competitive_strengths.description: Things that make this user stand out: prior FAANG internship, selective school, top GPA, named awards, published work, etc.

growth_areas.description: Honest weaknesses for calibration: early academic stage, no prior internship, GPA below median for target tier, etc.
